pandora_skin.label: Pandora: skin (0 = A teal, 1 = B oxblood)
pandora_skin.help: Skin A glows cyan; skin B is oxblood with red eyes, red suit seams and red strikes. See design/skins.md.

jump_push_show.label: Pandora: push-off picture after takeoff (s)
jump_push_show.help: How long the toes-pointed push-off shows after she leaves the ground, before the leap frames take over.

land_show.label: Pandora: landing picture (s)
land_show.help: How long the knees-soften landing shows after touchdown. It never delays her: any input moves on.

land_hard_show.label: Pandora: hard landing picture (s)
land_hard_show.help: After a long fall she lands in the deep lean-in crouch for this long (only when she lands standing still).

land_hard_drop.label: Pandora: fall height for a hard landing (px)
land_hard_drop.help: A fall from at least this high above the landing point uses the deep crouch. A full jump is about 68 px high.
